Photorealistic live-action rendering with the same character appearance as the references, placed against the background from <Picture 3>. The clip runs 10 seconds.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> is centered, seated, and facing the lens, against the colorful backdrop from <Picture 3>. She has a very low attention span and looks bored and restless. Over the 10 seconds she performs exactly three small, unrelated actions in this order, spaced out across the clip: she __100bored__. Each action is brief and understated, with a pause between them where she simply sits blankly. She stays seated and in place for the entire clip. Only her eyes, face, and fingers do anything, while her torso, shoulders, and seat position remain still. Her expression drifts between bored, vacant, and mildly curious, and she never holds eye contact with the lens for long.
